item.title: Gender, digital spaces and AI
item.description: Some of my recent work uses social media data, natural language processing and AI models to study gender inequalities in digital spaces: from violence against women in leadership positions to the digital strategies of feminist movements. -De los Santos, Daniela, Martin, Guillermina, Urriola, Ivonne & Voria, Andrea (2025). ‘Entre el menosprecio y las amenazas: análisis de violencia digital contra las mujeres en ocho países de Iberoamérica’. UNDP-LAC – Policy Notes 38.
